stories.headline: Oil Prices Plunge as U.S. Elections Shake Up the Iran War
stories.why: Flagged by keyword match on the headline/summary — check the source for full context.
stories.summary: December WTI crude oil is headed for one of its roughest weekly losses in months after the market shed $11.37, or 11.10%, from its opening price of $102.39. Prices posted a weekly high at $102.75 before breaking sharply
